features.title: Installs from a marketplace; the install sheet says it uses the computer's GitHub sign-in, talks to api.github.com and adds 3 widgets
Reads GitHub with the computer's own sign-in (GitHub CLI, else git) — no token asked, no raw settings card
With no sign-in on the computer: the section says how to sign in (gh auth login), Check again, a ! badge; widgets ask to sign in; GitHub is not asked
The sign-in is never shown, kept or logged by the plugin
What to show: organisations and recent repos found and offered (+), picked as chips (×), any repo or organisation added by name, one that isn't found says why
Nothing picked: the 10 repos pushed to last
GitHub repos widget: a row per repo, failing first — CI (naming failing workflows), open PRs, reviews for you
GitHub CI widget: the worst state across the repos; one failing repo opens its Actions page
GitHub at a glance widget: CI failing, open PRs, reviews for you (open issues on choice)
Each widget's settings pick what it shows
Reads every 5 minutes and on Refresh; a change on GitHub shows after it
GitHub down or refusing: the last answer stays, dated; the section says why; a renewed sign-in is picked up by itself
GitHub's text (repo, workflow names) is shown as text, never run as HTML
Removed: its section and widgets leave Echo
On real GitHub with a person's own gh sign-in: their organisations found, CI and counts match github.com
A thread's GitHub repos in its Profile: offered from your recent repos, added by name, taken off; kept per thread by Echo (gone with the thread)
Claude in Echo is told a thread's GitHub repos while it is open (a view hint)
GitHub's items on Today → My work with GitHub's icon: reviews asked of you, your PRs with changes asked or checks failing, issues assigned (milestone date); links ask before opening
A thread's Work tab: its repos' open pull requests and issues, with GitHub's icon
A widget set to a thread shows that thread's repos; none → says to add them in its Profile
